props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Whether the banner spans its container as a full-width strip.  `false` keeps it in the flow as a block with the standard chrome, for a message about one section rather than the whole page.

props.name: heading
props.description: Heading text. Named `heading`, not `title`, for the reason `sk-alert` records: `title` is a standardized `HTMLElement` member, so a prop by that name is shadowed by the prototype and the browser would surface it as a hover tooltip over the whole banner.

ai.summary: A page-level message that spans its container above the content it is about.
whenToUse: A site-wide notice — maintenance, degraded service, an expiring trial
A message that belongs to the whole page rather than to one section
A persistent status the reader can act on from an actions slot
whenNotToUse: It belongs to one section and sits in the flow — use an Alert
It must interrupt after a user action — use an Alert or a Toast
It floats above the page and dismisses — use a Toast
ai.accessibility: Sets `role="region"`, not `role="banner"` — in ARIA `banner` is the site header and is one-per-page, so using it here would collide with the consumer's real `<header>`. A `region` is only exposed as a landmark when it has an accessible name, so `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` is required for the banner to be reachable by landmark navigation; the React type enforces one of the two. An unnamed banner is left unnamed rather than given a made-up label. It is not a live region: a banner was already present when the page loaded, and announcing it as an interruption would talk over the content the reader came for. The glyph is decorative and hidden.
ai.example: <sk-banner variant="warning" heading="Scheduled maintenance" aria-label="Service status">Read-only on Saturday.</sk-banner>
knownLimitations: No dismiss button, by design: dismissing needs a close affordance, focus into it, and a focus return — a different component
`fullWidth` is geometry, not material: it drops the offset shadow and side borders because a shadow makes a box read as floating above the page
`heading` is a string, not a heading element — the component does not know its level in the document outline
